verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS video platform, but the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest item is the enterprise 'zero data retention options' (heygen-docs-29), which concerns data retention rather than telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
